title: Logos 31 opening: God’s self-knowledge vs ours
english: Thirty-first discourse. Against those who say God knows nothing more of his own essence than we do.
Creaturely knowledge is not made equal to God’s self-knowledge of the unbegotten.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
